div.h1: Tell us where you're going. We'll plan the days.
div.p: Describe your trip in a sentence. Wanderly AI builds a day-by-day itinerary that respects your budget, your pace and the queues you'd rather skip.

li.span: Pastel de nata at Manteigaria before the crowds
Ride tram 28 from Martim Moniz while it's still empty
Lunch in Alfama, book a table by the window
Sunset at Miradouro da Senhora do Monte

div.h2: Everything a trip plan needs, in one place
div.p: Six things that usually take a dozen browser tabs.

div.class: inline-flex items-center justify-center w-11 h-11 mb-4 text-brand-700 bg-brand-100 rounded-lg

article.p: Set a total or a daily cap. Every stop is priced before it lands on your plan.

div.class: inline-flex items-center justify-center w-11 h-11 mb-4 text-brand-700 bg-brand-100 rounded-lg

article.p: No four-museum days. Walking, meals and rest are spaced the way you like to travel.

div.class: inline-flex items-center justify-center w-11 h-11 mb-4 text-brand-700 bg-brand-100 rounded-lg

article.p: Don't like a stop? Replace it and the rest of the day re-flows around the change.

div.class: inline-flex items-center justify-center w-11 h-11 mb-4 text-brand-700 bg-brand-100 rounded-lg

article.p: Save your itinerary and maps for the moments you have no signal.

div.class: inline-flex items-center justify-center w-11 h-11 mb-4 text-brand-700 bg-brand-100 rounded-lg

article.p: Share a link, collect votes on stops and settle it before anyone books.

div.class: inline-flex items-center justify-center w-11 h-11 mb-4 text-brand-700 bg-brand-100 rounded-lg

article.p: Opening hours, closing days and the best time to visit are checked for you.

div.class: max-w-screen-xl mx-auto px-4 grid gap-10 lg:grid-cols-12

div.p: Pick a trip type to see what changes in your plan.

div.class: hidden p-6 mt-4 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl
div.p: Flexible days, well-lit walking routes home and social spots like walking tours and shared tables when you want company.

div.class: hidden p-6 mt-4 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl
div.p: Sunset viewpoints, tables worth booking and a free evening each day so the trip never feels scheduled.

div.class: hidden p-6 mt-4 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl
div.h3: Plans with nap time built in
div.p: Short transfers, kid-friendly meals and a quiet break every afternoon, with backup ideas for rainy days.

div.class: hidden p-6 mt-4 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl
div.p: Share the draft, vote on stops and split costs. The plan updates as soon as the group decides.

h2.class: max-w-2xl font-display text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-ink

div.h2: From idea to itinerary in three steps

span.class: absolute left-0 top-0 inline-flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 font-display text-lg font-bold text-white bg-brand-600 rounded-full

li.p: Type where, how long and what you enjoy. Plain sentences work.

span.class: absolute left-0 top-0 inline-flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 font-display text-lg font-bold text-white bg-brand-600 rounded-full

li.p: Get a full itinerary with times, costs and travel between stops in seconds.

span.class: absolute left-0 top-0 inline-flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 font-display text-lg font-bold text-white bg-brand-600 rounded-full

li.p: Swap stops, change the budget, then save the plan for offline use.

button.class: flex items-center justify-between w-full p-5 font-medium text-left border border-b-0 border-slate-200 rounded-t-xl hover:bg-slate-50 gap-3
button.span: Is the itinerary really generated by AI?

div.div: In this project preview the planner runs on sample logic in your browser. The full version will send your description to a language model, then check every stop against opening hours and prices.

button.class: flex items-center justify-between w-full p-5 font-medium text-left border border-b-0 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 gap-3
button.span: Can I change the plan after it's generated?

div.div: Yes. Swap any stop, change the budget or add a day, and the rest of the itinerary adjusts around it.

button.class: flex items-center justify-between w-full p-5 font-medium text-left border border-b-0 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 gap-3
button.span: Do you book flights and hotels?

div.div: No. We link out to the provider so you always book directly and keep control of your money.

button.class: flex items-center justify-between w-full p-5 font-medium text-left border border-slate-200 rounded-b-xl hover:bg-slate-50 gap-3

div.div: Your trips are private to your account. We use them to build your plans and never sell them.
